subject: CAIQ staging window and sample payloads for telemetry/log extraction
messages:
From: Sam Park <sam.park@helios.io>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@helios.io
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ staging window + sample payloads

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our CAIQ intake we're trying to schedule a short staging session where your team can show how Redwood will pull telemetry/log samples and a small set of application payloads from our non-prod tenant. Goal is to validate the log extraction approach and sizing for our SOC2 auditors.

Quick asks so we can prep on our side:
- Can you propose a 60-min window this week (PST) for the demo + extraction run?
- We will need a sample list of expected filenames + formats (e.g., jsonl traces, compressed logs).
- Any minimal service-account/KMS permissions you'd need for temporary access?

I can do any slot after 1pm PST on Wed/Thu.

Thanks,
Sam Park
Security Eng, Helios Systems

--
Attachment: desired_assets_example.csv (stub)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@helios.io>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CAIQ staging window + sample payloads

Hi Sam — thanks for the clear list. Wed or Thu after 1pm PST works for us; proposing Thu 2026-11-25 14:00-15:00 PST (60m). Irene and Marissa will run the walkthrough; Ben will prepare the KV/prefix cache snapshot and a small log slice.

On the artifacts: we typically ask for a non-prod export with the following minimal items:
- small telemetry payloads: up to 100 jsonl request/response records (redacted PII)
- KV cache snapshot: a short JSONL file showing ~2k keys (we can provide a template)
- compressed server logs: a 50–200MB tar.gz sample (one hour of traffic)

Permissions: a temporary read-only service principal with object-list and object-get on the designated staging bucket is sufficient. If you need, we can provide a scoped IAM template and a pre-signed upload link.

I've attached a short manifest template (staging_manifest_v1.csv) and our preferred kv_cache_sample.jsonl schema. Please let us know if Helios requires different formats.

Next steps:
1) Confirm Thu 11/25 14:00 PST or suggest alternative.
2) Share the staging manifest + sample uploads (or pre-signed link) 24 hours prior.
3) We'll run extraction during the call and capture the exact commands for the CAIQ evidence pack.

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Security Programs Manager, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: staging_manifest_v1.csv (stub); kv_cache_sample.jsonl (stub)

From: Sam Park <sam.park@helios.io>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@helios.io
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ staging window + sample payloads

Lauren — Thu 11/25 14:00 PST works. We'll upload the manifest and samples to a pre-signed bucket link by Wed 11/24 14:00 PST. A few clarifying items from our infra team:

- Log format: most of our logs are JSON lines with a timestamp, request_id, and message. We'll also include an Apache combined log excerpt if needed.
- Telemetry: we can export traces as jsonl with request/response bodies redacted. Does Redwood prefer a redacted field named "payload" or full removal?
- KMS: for the staging run we will not grant KMS decrypt — we'll provide plain object access to a staging bucket.

One security question: during extraction will any KV values be written back to Helios environments? We want to ensure read-only behavior.

Thanks — Sam

--

Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 16:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ staging window + sample payloads — confirmed

Sam — confirmed for Thu 2026-11-25 14:00-15:00 PST (calendar invite sent). A couple of final clarifications so auditors have clear context:

- Read-only guaranteed: during the extraction we will run only object-get/list and read the provided artifacts; we will not perform any writes to your environment. We'll state this explicitly in the CAIQ evidence note.
- Payload redaction: please replace request/response bodies with a redacted "payload": "<REDACTED>" field — that maps to our intake pipeline and preserves schema for auditors. Full removal of sensitive fields is also acceptable; we'll adapt parsing accordingly.
- Deliverables expected by Wed 11/24 14:00 PST: staging_manifest_v1.csv, kv_cache_sample.jsonl (per template), log_excerpt_20261122.tar.gz or equivalent. If you run into upload issues, reply and we'll create a pre-signed PUT for each file.

Agenda for the 60m call:
1) Intro + scope (5m)
2) Extraction run (30m) — live capture of commands and evidence bundle creation
3) CAIQ artifact walkthrough (15m) — show where evidence will be stored and labeling
4) Next steps and outstanding Qs (10m)

We will also capture a short recording and save it to the Helios evidence folder (permissioned link only). Looking forward to it.

Best,
Lauren
Security Programs Manager, Redwood Inference
